blurb: The ferry offers scenic round-trip rides to Kelleys Island, accommodating cars, bikes, buses, and even dump trucks. The trip takes about 20 minutes across Lake Erie. The ferry is pet-friendly and provides seating on an open deck and below deck.

quotes.author: John S. III • Google
quotes.text: Had the pleasure of taking the Kelley’s Island Ferry to Kelley’s Island, Ohio for the 2024 Solar eclipse. The men and women were hardworking, professional and helpful. Having never taken a ferry before, I along with my kids enjoyed the “boat” ride for our family and our car. The ferry was always on time, and safety was priority number one. Thank you Kelley’s Island Ferry for ensuring the safe arrival and departure for my family.

quotes.author: 3Delta7 • Google
quotes.text: Nice easy relaxing ride over to Kelley's Island. Open deck upstairs included area for seating below. Quite considering the engine power. Open for cars.restrooms are clean and tidy. Dogs welcome. Passengers can stand on car deck. Trip took about 20 minutes but views are incredible of Lake Erie.

quotes.author: Judy H. • Google
quotes.text: Was an enjoyable ride across the lake and very reasonable rates for both cars and passengers. It was on time and the ferry itself had a well maintained look (no rust!) and there were even seats for sitting on the ride across, which was so appreciated by me for my sore, arthritic knees.

quotes.author: Adam W. • Google
quotes.text: A load of vehicles on quickly. They get them off quickly. Rates are reasonable. Line up early if you want to make sure you get a spot otherwise you might be waiting for the next ferry. Good launch point for fishing off of Kelley Island in a kayak.

quotes.author: Tama O. • Google
quotes.text: It was a perfect time. I loved this place it was like a little secluded piece of heaven. I WILL definitely be back, and spread the word for all my friends to visit there!!
